title: Sunny Side Up | Real Joy
meta_description: Welcome to Sunny Side Up, a beautifully designed 3BR + bonus room beach cottage in the gated WaterSound West community along Scenic 30A. With resort-style amenities, beach access, and bikes included, this home is ideal for families, friends, and snowbirds seeking a relaxing coastal escape.⭐
description_expanded: Welcome to Sunny Side Up, a beautifully designed 3BR + bonus room beach cottage in the gated WaterSound West community along Scenic 30A. With resort-style amenities, beach access, and bikes included, this home is ideal for families, friends, and snowbirds seeking a relaxing coastal escape.⭐ Why Guests Love It3BR + Bonus Room | 3.5 Baths7 bikes includedBeach access via scenic boardwalk (~950 yards)Zero-entry community pool (heated seasonally)Gated neighborhood with trails, parks and boardwalksLarge screened-in porchNear Greenway Station, Café 30A & Old Florida Fish House3.5 miles to Seaside | 5 miles to Rosemary Beach24/7 professional management🚫 No guests under age 25. No exceptions.🏡 The SpaceThe open-concept living area features hardwood floors, coastal décor, and a fully equipped kitchen with granite countertops, stainless appliances, and a gas range. Relax indoors or unwind on the screened porch after a beach day.Sleeping Arrangements1st Floor: King primary suite with ensuite bath2nd Floor: Queen suite with ensuite, twin bedroomBonus Room: Twin-over-full bunk bedSleeper sofa + upstairs sitting area with 50” TV🌴 Community AmenitiesResort-style zero-entry pool with cabanas, grills & fireplaceNature trails, ponds & direct beach accessClose to Deer Lake State Park & outdoor adventures🚲 ExtrasBikes allowed on community streets and beach walkover (HOA rules apply, ask for details)Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef near Grayton Beach❄️ Snowbirds WelcomeLow monthly winter rates available January–February (additional cleaning fee applies). Contact us for details.✨ Book Sunny Side Up and enjoy the best of 30A—beaches, bikes, and unforgettable memories. Read less
